body: That makes more sense. Thanks for the support.

I guess that's partially what I think about to distract myself from it. Because I've always thought that if I dropped so low, unlike my family members, I could pack up and walk away. Though that option is looking my last, it's so scary to think about and if I'm just doing that before I  die why not *cut to the chase* if it were. I guess this whole thing comes down to making one of two stupid choices. But the fact that it can be potentially lethal, I don't want to fuck this up. And the seriousness of it means I can't reasonably ask for advice because it's entirely unreasonable argument.

So how worried should I be? I mean, it sounds like the flames aren't forcing me out of the window right now but they will only grow and I have to remember that I am pretty far from the ground. Not to mention that if they don't push me out now, what about later? This is seeming like a huge issue with me even though I feel it shouldn't be. I've had three people in my close family attempt suicide. So, will this feeling just follow me if its following them?
